## Why This Is Asked
Tests for offline-first flows are common in modern apps; this checks basic E2E coverage, data integrity, and sync behavior.

## Key Concepts
- Offline-first UI and service workers
- Background sync and idempotent requests
- Network emulation, data seeding, test isolation
- Conflict handling strategies for concurrent edits

## Code Example
```javascript
// Example Cypress-like flow (pseudo)
cy.visit('/notes')
cy.window().then(w => w.navigator.onLine = false)
cy.get('#new-note').type('Offline note')
cy.get('#save').click()
cy.window().then(w => w.navigator.onLine = true)
cy.wait('@backgroundSync')
cy.get('.note-item').should('contain', 'Offline note')
```
